response.evidence: Click on Show Advanced under the URL field and toggle the option to select Disable Payload. With the payload disabled, Builder sends a simpler POST request to your hosting provider, which can be helpful as your site grows. Click Done to save this selection.
response.rationale: Under 'Adding a webhook to Builder', the steps run in order: open the model's webhook settings (Edit Webhooks), add a webhook and paste the URL, then show advanced options, disable the payload, and click Done to save. The last of these is disabling the payload and saving, which matches option 1.
